parameters.name: AlbServerGroup
parameters.description: The list of ALB server groups.

sub_parameters.name: AlbServerGroupId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the ALB server group. N specifies the sequence number of the ALB server group.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port number used by ECS instances in the ALB server group. N specifies the sequence number of the ALB server group.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

parameters.name: ForceDetach
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove existing ECS instances from the ALB server groups to be detached.

- true: removes the instances and returns a ScalingActivityId. You can check the scaling activity ID to determine whether the existing instances are removed.

- false: does not remove the instances.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group, such as ap-southeast-1. For more information, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.
